verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own API surfaces: a Deployments API authenticated with an external access token, plus API upload of source maps, dSYMs and ProGuard files. That counts as direct but narrow programmatic control. The evidence shows no general API for querying errors, changing statuses or managing apps, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. The MCP server belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented general-purpose REST API covering core crash-reporting objects (error groups, statuses, apps), published API reference or OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files, Uploading JavaScript files directly to Raygun
you can also manually upload source maps either through our website using the `JS source map center` or via our API
